_comment: NeMo Data Designer recipe template for RFT prompt generation from document chunks. Copy this file, replace <PLACEHOLDERS>, and customize the prompts for your domain.

columns.name: system_prompt
columns.prompt:
Write a concise system prompt (2-3 sentences) for an assistant that will be trained with reinforcement fine-tuning. Define the assistant's role, boundaries, and response style using only the ideas supported by the source chunk. Adapt the tone for a {{difficulty}} user.

Source chunk:
{{chunk_text}}

Return only the system prompt.

columns.name: user_message
columns.prompt:
Generate one realistic user message for a reinforcement fine-tuning prompt. The message must be answerable from the source chunk and should ask for explanation, comparison, application, or analysis rather than trivial definition lookup. Keep it natural and specific for a {{difficulty}} user.

Source chunk:
{{chunk_text}}

Return only the user message.

scores.description: Whether the prompt is answerable from the source chunk.

options.medium: Mostly grounded with some loose inference.
options.low: Not well grounded or requires missing information.

scores.description: Whether the row is useful as an RFT prompt.

options.medium: Usable but somewhat generic or vague.
